name: Karam ES005 Clear Polycarbonate Anti-Scratch Safety Spectacles
shortDescription: Frameless wrap-around clear safety glasses with optical class 1 polycarbonate lens, hard anti-scratch coating, and 99.9% UV protection for workshop eye defense.
overview: The Karam ES005 is an ultra-lightweight, ergonomic safety spectacle designed to protect personnel against high-speed flying particles, chemical splashes, and radiant optical hazards. Constructed with a 100% optical-grade virgin polycarbonate unitary lens, it provides an expansive, distortion-free panoramic field of vision with integrated side shields and a protective browguard. The lens is treated on both faces with an advanced hard coating that resists scratching from metal dust, while filtering out 99.9% of harmful ultraviolet (UVA/UVB) radiation.
keyFeatures: Unitary frameless wrap-around lens provides completely unobstructed panoramic vision
Optical Class 1 clarity guarantees zero distortion or eye strain during 8-hour continuous wear
High impact resistance tested with 6mm steel ball at 45 m/s conforming to EN 166 F
Hard-coated anti-scratch coating extends lens life in gritty grinding and sanding environments
Blocks 99.9% of harmful ultraviolet (UVA & UVB) radiation up to 385 nm
Soft flexible temple arms with molded ear rests provide gentle, slip-free retention
Certified to ANSI Z87.1-2010 and EN 166:2001 safety standards
applications: Angle grinding, deburring, lathe turning, and milling operations
Woodworking, routing, sanding, and chainsaw operations
Light chemical dispensing, laboratory testing, and liquid sampling
General site visits, warehouse auditing, and construction supervision
specsSummary: Lens Material: 100% Optical Grade Polycarbonate | Optical Class: Class 1 (Continuous Wear)
